waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Here's what to do this weekend in Tesoro Highlands and around Santa Clarita.

🎵 *Fri 10:30 AM* — Music Time with Mr. Michael (free)
   Perfect for the littles on Friday morning
🎸 *Fri 4 PM* — Loud @ the Library: Powered by Music Lab 🎸 (free)
   Free live music for kids and teens Friday
🎃 *Sat 9 AM* — Gilchrist Farm Harvest Festival & Pumpkin Patch (from $10)
   Harvest fun with pumpkins and farm activities
🎪 *Sat* — Circus Vargas - Masquerade ($25-$90)
   Circus Vargas brings spectacle and fun for all ages
📚 *Sat 1 PM* — Tales From the Dark Stacks (free)
   Spooky storytelling for adults Saturday afternoon
🎭 *Sat 7 PM* — Dial M for Murder ($20)
   Local theater production, perfect for a date night

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
